    for u, v, w in edges:

        adj[v][u] = adj[v].get(u, 0) + w
        deg[u] += w
        deg[v] += w
    m = sum(w for _, _, w in edges)  # total edge weight

    comm_sum_tot = {}
    for node in nodes:
        c = communities[node]
        comm_sum_tot[c] = comm_sum_tot.get(c, 0) + deg[node]
    moves = []
    # local moving iterations
    changed = True
    # order nodes sorted for determinism
    node_order = sorted(nodes)
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for node in node_order:
            current_comm = communities[node]
            # Compute w_i for each community
            w_comm = {}
            for nb, w in adj[node].items():
                nb_comm = communities[nb]
                w_comm[nb_comm] = w_comm.get(nb_comm, 0) + w

                    gain = 0.0

                    w_A = w_comm.get(current_comm, 0)  # edges to own community

                    best_gain = gain
                    best_comm = target_comm

                to_comm = best_comm
